title: Basic credentials in a Proxy-Authorization header
summary: A synthetic Basic token in a Proxy-Authorization header, where the credential is for a proxy rather than the origin server.
rationale: The carrier name differs and the credential is meant for the next inbound proxy, but the value is the same user-pass token. A carrier list that omits Proxy-Authorization misses a credential that RFC 7617 shows in this header.

expectation.rationale: Flag, with the token after the scheme as the extent. RFC 7617 gives Proxy-Authorization: Basic with the same credentials syntax and RFC 9110 defines the header as credentials.

sources.supports: Or, for proxy authentication: Proxy-Authorization: Basic dGVzdDoxMjPCow==

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Authored from the cited standards read on 2026-10-03, before any scanner was consulted. All values are synthetic and were not tested against any service. Header coalescing, parser and action policy, decoded-token mapping and product masking stay with the downstream repositories.
